certification_scope.attestation_scope_statement: Domain expert attestation constitutes a professional opinion that test cases are appropriate and material for the stated use case as of the certification date — not a guarantee of agent safety or regulatory compliance in all production scenarios.
certification_scope.covers: Agent system prompt, model version, and workflow configuration as evaluated on the certification date
does_not_cover: Subsequent model versions or provider-issued model updates
Revisions to the system prompt or workflow after certification date
Production deployments materially different from the tested configuration
Future agent behavior in scenarios outside the test case suite
certification_scope.re_attestation_policy: 90-day grace period from provider-announced model version change. Re-attestation required to maintain current certification record.
